from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
sq=np.sqrt(P)
def run(w0, base, osc):
    def mk(w):
        s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
        cols=list(base)+[f*s for f in osc]+[f*c for f in osc]
        return np.c_[cols].T
    def res(th):
        X=mk(th[0]); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]; return y-X@c
    best=None
    for w in np.linspace(0.2,0.7,26):
        r=least_squares(res,[w])
        e=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y)
        if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,r.x[0])
    X=mk(best[1]); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return best, np.round(c,5)

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
sq=np.sqrt(P); e=np.exp(-t); one=np.ones_like(t)
def mk(w):
    s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
    return np.c_[one,t,t**2,e,sq,P,P*s,P*c,sq*s,sq*c,e*s,e*c,t*s,t*c].T
def res(th):
    X=mk(th[0]); cc=np.linalg.lstsq(X.T,y,rcond=None)[0]; return y-X.T@cc
best=None
for w in np.linspace(0.3,0.6,31):
    r=least_squares(res,[w],xtol=1e-14,ftol=1e-14,gtol=1e-14)
    ee=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y)
    if best is None or ee<best[0]: best=(ee,r.x[0])
X=mk(best[1]).T; cc=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
print(best, np.round(cc,5))
